_comment: Pinned SG13G2 PDK revision this sim/ tree's committed evidence records were generated against. Every record under sim/*/records/ must trace to this file (or to a later commit that bumps it). Not consumed by tooling; kept as a plain, greppable fact sheet. Each record additionally states the exact PDK_ROOT and ngspice version its own run used, plus sha256 of the model libraries it loaded, so a reader can tell whether their environment matches without re-deriving it from this file alone.
tarball_sha256_source: 2AMLogic/klayout-tools scripts/fetch-ihp-sg13g2.sh (IHP_OPEN_PDK_SHA256), cross-checked 2026-09-06 against the local install by file-level sha256 of libs.tech/ngspice/models/{capacitors_mod.lib,cornerCAP.lib} -- see sim/tank-characterization/records/ for the per-record digests
fetch_method: klayout-tools scripts/fetch-ihp-sg13g2.sh (2AMLogic/klayout-tools), which downloads the tagged tarball, verifies the sha256 above, and lays it out open_pdks-shaped under PDK_ROOT/ihp-sg13g2
pdk_root_layout: PDK_ROOT/ihp-sg13g2 (open_pdks-shaped install, klt pdk find/list convention)

documented_tool_versions_from_pdk_versio.note: These are the tool versions IHP's own versions.txt records for this release. This repo's records state the ngspice version actually used, which may be newer.

known_model_gaps._comment: Devices this block needs that IHP-Open-PDK v0.3.0 does NOT ship an ngspice-simulatable model for. Recorded here because a missing model is a first-class constraint on what this repo can evidence, not a footnote. See sim/tank-characterization/README.md for the search that established this.
known_model_gaps.spiral_inductor: ABSENT for ngspice. v0.3.0 ships inductor LAYOUT and LVS support only: KLayout PCells (libs.tech/klayout/python/sg13g2_pycell_lib/ihp/inductor{s,2,3}_code.py), LVS extraction/derivation rules (libs.tech/klayout/tech/lvs/rule_decks/ind_*.lvs), xschem symbols (libs.tech/xschem/sg13g2_pr/inductor{,3}.sym) and a Qucs-S symbol. No .subckt or .model named `inductor` exists anywhere under libs.tech/ngspice/models/. The Qucs-S component descriptor (libs.tech/qucs-s/symbols/inductor_2.xml) carries `L` as the placeholder equation `w*s`, which is dimensionally meaningless as an inductance and is not a compact model. IHP's own intended path is EM extraction (libs.doc/doc/EM_Simulation_Overview.pdf; libs.tech/openems/), and libs.tech/openems/openems_ihp_sg13g2/ is a git submodule (github.com/VolkerMuehlhaus/openems_ihp_sg13g2) that is EMPTY in the release tarball, because GitHub source tarballs never carry submodule contents.
known_model_gaps.spiral_inductor_substitute: This gap is UNCHANGED in the PDK -- the entry above is still literally true of v0.3.0. What changed is that this repo now supplies its own stand-in: sim/inductor-model/sg13g2_inductor_analytic.spice, a `.subckt inductor la lb sub` (params w, s, d, nr_r) built from published closed-form expressions (Mohan et al. 1999) evaluated on the PDK's own published process constants. It is an ANALYTIC SCREENING model with stated error bars (+/-5 % on L, +/-10 % single-turn, Q an UPPER BOUND because lateral current crowding and substrate eddy-current loss are unmodelled, valid 0.5-20 GHz and only below the device's own SRF) -- NOT a PDK model and NOT an EM extraction. Any record that used it names it by repo-relative path and content sha256. Route decision, derivation, validation and the full error budget: sim/inductor-model/README.md. Replacing it with an EM extraction of the PDK's own PCell is tracked as issue #9.
known_model_gaps.mos_varactor_verilog_a: NOT absent, but NOT a directly ngspice-simulatable model either: `sg13_hv_svaricap` (sg13g2_svaricaphv_mod.lib, cornerMOShv.lib) instantiates a Verilog-A compact model (`.model sg13_hv_svaricap mosvar`, source libs.tech/verilog-a/mosvar/mosvar.va) that ngspice can only run via an OSDI-compiled shared library, loaded with `pre_osdi` before the first analysis command. v0.3.0's release tarball happens to ship a PREBUILT libs.tech/ngspice/osdi/mosvar.osdi alongside the source, but its build provenance (compiler, version, build date) is undocumented in the release. sim/varactor-characterization/ (#18) does not rely on that prebuilt binary: sim/tools/build-osdi.sh (ported, scoped to mosvar, from 2AMLogic/sg13g2-opamp's sim/tools/build-osdi.sh) compiles the PDK's own Verilog-A source with the checksum-pinned OpenVAF-Reloaded release in osdi_toolchain below, and every record names both the source (.va) and the resulting (.osdi) file by content sha256.

osdi_toolchain._comment: Provenance of the OSDI (Verilog-A compact model) binary sim/varactor-characterization/'s testbenches load. sim/tools/build-osdi.sh is the executable source of truth (ported from 2AMLogic/sg13g2-opamp's sim/tools/build-osdi.sh, scoped down to the one model this repo currently needs); this block restates its pins as a greppable fact sheet. Note the key above this block is documented_tool_versions_from_pdk_versions_txt (IHP's own versions.txt claims openvaf 23.5.0), NOT documented_tool_versions -- the compiler this repo actually invokes is pinned independently below and need not match that version.
osdi_toolchain.approach: source-compile the PDK's own Verilog-A model with a checksum-pinned prebuilt OpenVAF-Reloaded compiler, rather than trust the PDK release's prebuilt .osdi binary of undocumented provenance
osdi_toolchain.install_dir: PDK_ROOT/ihp-sg13g2/libs.tech/ngspice/osdi (PDK-install territory, not tracked in this repo)
osdi_toolchain.note: Scoped to mosvar only -- this repo's testbenches do not yet instantiate PSP103 or r3_cmc. Extend build-osdi.sh's MODELS/REQUIRED_OSDI arrays the day one does.
